tasks.description: Create a data retention policy that deletes user activity data after 30 days for GDPR compliance. This policy should be enforced by an automated pipeline and apply to all user activity records without exception.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user activity record, when 30 days have passed since its creation, then the record is deleted from the event store.

tasks.description: Develop an automated job that deletes user activity data older than 30 days from the event store. This job should run periodically to ensure data retention policy is enforced.
acceptance_criteria: Given the automated deletion job, when it runs, then all user activity data older than 30 days is deleted from the event store.

tasks.description: Design and implement a data archiving solution that retains the complete historical event log for trend analysis. This solution should ensure that no activity events are deleted and the event log remains complete and queryable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the data archiving solution, when querying the event log, then all historical event data is available and queryable.

tasks.description: Implement access controls to restrict access to the event store to authorized personnel only. All access should be logged for auditing purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unauthorized user, when attempting to access the event store, then access is denied and the attempt is logged.

tasks.description: Develop a logging solution that tracks all access to the event store for auditing purposes. This solution should ensure that all access attempts are logged and stored securely.
acceptance_criteria: Given an access attempt to the event store, when the attempt is made, then the attempt is logged and stored securely.

tasks.description: Create documentation that outlines the data retention policy, including the automated deletion job and data archiving solution. This documentation should be accessible to all stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when a stakeholder reviews it, then the documentation accurately reflects the data retention policy.

tasks.description: Identify and resolve any inconsistencies between the data retention policy and the automated deletion job or data archiving solution. This task should ensure that the policy is enforced consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Given the data retention policy, when the automated deletion job or data archiving solution is run, then the policy is enforced consistently and without errors.
